leadText:
(Japanese: ポケモンレンジャー オブリビアの勇者 Pokémon Ranger: Hero of Oblivia) is one of the adaptations of Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs. It was published in Bessatsu CoroCoro Comic and authored by Shinjou Maki.
